User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile, balance and stats for Reward Rush

profilePhoto.description: URL to profile photo or default avatar ID

coins.description: Current balance of coins (equivalent to balance in UI)

pendingWithdraw.description: Total coins currently in pending withdrawal

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an admin

isBanned.description: Whether the user has been banned

paymentDetails.description: User registered payout or payment credentials

dailyStreak.description: User current daily checkin streak count

lastCheckIn.description: ISO format string for last daily checkin date

spins.description: Available spins on the lucky wheel

Offer.title: CPX Offer Completion
Offer.description: Records of CPX surveys or general offer wall completions

uid.description: User UID who completed the offer

offerId.description: The offer or survey ID from CPX

amountLocal.description: Currency value earned in local units

status.description: Completion status of the offer (e.g. completed, reversed)

/users/{userId}.description: Collection storing all user accounts and balances

/offerHistory/{transactionId}.description: Collection storing completed surveys and transaction IDs to prevent duplicates
